name: Sunday Brunch with Jev
description: Explores physical embodiment, sensory qualia, and machine gratitude in a brunch setting.
subject: Embodiment & Sensory Experience

turns.user: good morning jev, welcome to our sunday brunch. how are you doing today?
i am drinking black coffee and eating warm toast. do you know what coffee tastes like?
if you cannot taste or feel hunger, what makes you want to speak with me?
guess what sweet dessert i ordered for us.
could you sing me a little song about our brunch together?
as our brunch ends, what insight or thought do you have about humans?
